description:
This item reports the value of the SMC FPGA "2BIT_ERR_SHUTDOWN" fields from the EDAC_REG register. This telemetry item is a
 bitmask where each bit represents an auto-shutdown flag for an individual type of EDAC Error.
 Bit 6: RD_RAM_EDAC
 Bit 5: CMD_FIFO_EDAC
 Bit 4: ACT_LOOP_STOR_RAM_EDAC
 Bit 3: ACT_LOOP_CONF_RAM_EDAC

 Bit 1: SNS_LOOP_STOR_RAM_EDAC

synopsis: SMC FPGA Revision and Configuration ID
description:
This item reports the value of the SMC FPGA FPGA_VERSION register:
 Bits 31:16: CFG_ID_* register settings. The FPGA's "Configuration ID" is controlled by the version number within the FPGA configuration file
 used to configure the FPGA for operations.
 Bits 15:8: FPGA MAJOR_REV
 Bits 7:0: FPGA MINOR_REV

Cumulative error bits from the SMC MISC_ERR register. These bits indicate whether a control loop overcurrent and/or EDAC error occurred.
 To clear these bits in telemetry, use the CLEAR_LOG(EVENT) command.

synopsis: SMC PCI telemetry collection completion setting
description:
This item reports the value of the SMC FPGA PCI_TLM_COMPLETION register setting. This value indicates whether the SMC FPGA
 should continuously collection PCI telemetry data, or only collection one set of data.

synopsis: Number of telemetry words to collect - 1
description:
This item reports the value of the SMC FPGA PCI_TLM_CONTROL_COLLECT_COUNT register setting. This value indicates how many
 telemetry items to collect.

This item reports the value of the SMC FPGA PCI_TLM_RATE register setting. This value indicates at what rate the telemetry collection is
 configured. Collection can be programmed to be synchronized with Actuator or Sensor Processing Loop rate, or a programmable multiple of
 the Sensor Processing Loop rate.

synopsis: The period of the SMC FPGA Sensor processing loop
description: This item reports the value of the SMC FPGA SENSOR_ADC_PERIOD register setting.

synopsis: Variable-length array of SMC telemetry sets
description:
Variable-length array of timestamped SMC telemetry sets (see SMC_TLM_NUM_SETS, nominally 128).
 Each SMC telemetry set contains:
 1) 32-bit SMA timestamp
 2) Array of N 32-bit values (configured by SMC FPGA table, N=SMC_TLM_NUM_ITEMS-1):
 1) 32-bit floating point SMC tlm value,
 N) 32-bit floating point SMC tlm value,

synopsis: Number of milliseconds between consecutive SMC TLM collections
description:
This telemetry item reports the amount of time in milliseconds that has elapsed between the previous SMC telemetry collection and the
 current one.

synopsis: Telemetry collection status for the SMC FPGA
description: This item reports the ICE FSW flag indicating if telemetry collection via the PCI interface has been enabled.

synopsis: Amount of time in microseconds for the most recent TLM collection
description:
This telemetry item reports the amount of time in microseconds that it took to collect SMC telemetry from the board and copy it into
 processor RAM.

synopsis: The period of the SMC FPGA telemetry collection loop
description:
This item reports the value of the SMC FPGA TLM_LOOP_PERIOD register setting. When item SMC_PCITLM_RATE is set to
 'SENS_LOOP_MULT', this telemtery item indicates the PCI telemetry collection rate in terms of number of Sensor Processing Loops
 between each telemetry collection. Refer to SMC FRD for information on how to configure this register.

synopsis: Number of items in each SMC tlm set
description:
Number of 32-bit items (including the timestamp) in each SMC telemetry set. This value is in the range 2-64.
 This value should be 16 for nominal telemetry collection.
 This value is configured by the SMC FPGA table.

synopsis: Number of complete SMC Telemetry Sets
description:
Number of complete SMA telemetry sets contained within the SMC_TLM packet.
 This value should be 128 for nominal telemetry collection.
 This value changes depending on the value of SMC_TLM_NUM_ITEMS: configuring the SMC to collect a number of items different from
 4/8/16/32/64 might cause a partial telemetry set to be included in the SMC_TLM packet.

synopsis: Number of bytes in the last partial set

 4/8/16/32/64 might cause a partial telemetry set to be included in the SMC_TLM packet.
